commits_data.title: ippusb: remove broken herustic based on assumed ipp operation id
commits_data.message:
ippusb: remove broken herustic based on assumed ipp operation id

The status_code is expected to be the IPP operation-type, but it
is not. While IPP operation-type is the bytes 2-3 of IPP packet,
the packet seen by IPPUSB dissector is not straight up the IPP
PDU. This is obvious as the status_code is used in same if block
with is_http_header() which assumes the packet starts with HTTP
headers.

Because the code breaks on small packets (reads beyond end of
packet) and reads from incorrect location anything based on it
is wrong. Remove the heuristic and any assumptions made based
on it.

This fixes decoding of dumps with small USB packets.

commits_data.title: ippusb: hook interface protocol instead of bulk type
commits_data.message:
ippusb: hook interface protocol instead of bulk type

The bulk handler is run after heuristic dissectors. This caused
AT dissector to eat some packets, and possibly the injection
of newline packets was added to workaround this.

Use the official IPPUSB protocol and HP vendor specific protocols
instead to get always called.

This allows to remove the newline synthesis that worked incorrectly
depending on how the HTTP traffic was split over USB bulk transfers.

Always have the dissector also report the packet taken as we know
it belongs to us. Simplify things.
